privacyPolicyText:
Last Updated: May 19, 2026

Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Puntos collects and uses your information.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect:
• Name, email, and contact details
• Loyalty points and transaction history
• Device and app usage information

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your data to:
• Provide and improve the app
• Manage rewards and transactions
• Prevent fraud and security issues
• Send important updates and support messages

3. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal data. We may share limited information with:
• Participating merchants
• Service providers and analytics tools
• Authorities when required by law

4. Data Security

We use reasonable security measures to protect your information, but no system is completely secure.

5. Your Rights

You may request to:
• Access your information
• Correct inaccurate data
• Request account or data deletion

6. Policy Updates

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated policy.
